design_description: A warm cream jersey with a distressed, grunge-inspired graphic treatment. The base is covered with irregular grey brush marks, scratches and paint fragments, giving the kit a worn, raw character. Deep burgundy/red accents provide the contrast, appearing on the collar and cuffs and through sharp diagonal brush strokes that become much stronger toward the lower body. The asymmetrical placement keeps the pattern energetic rather than repetitive. The back carries the same distressed artwork, paired with a burgundy player name and large number. Overall, The Sleepers design feels raw, vintage and slightly rebellious, with the cream base keeping the heavy grunge graphics balanced.
